memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Depression
  - Status: New onset, PHQ-9 not yet done, reports low mood, anhedonia, poor sleep.
  - Plan: Start sertraline 50 mg OD after breakfast, advise sleep hygiene, schedule PHQ-9 in 4 weeks.
- Weight
  - Status: Weight 68 kg, waist 78 cm (female cut‑off 80 cm, within limit).
  - Plan: Encourage balanced diet, monitor weight.
Due: HbA1c not indicated; next review in 3 months.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: TSH 2.1 mIU/L (0.4‑4.0). Vitamin B12 340 pg/mL (200‑900). CBC: WBC 6.2x10^9/L, Hb 13.8 g/dL, Plt 240x10^9/L.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Penicillin – rash and pruritus on exposure.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling down most days, hard to get out of bed, and I wake up at 3 am unable to sleep again.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Depression
  - Status: PHQ-9 12 (moderate), reports some improvement in mood but still fatigue.
  - Plan: Add escitalopram 10 mg OD after dinner, continue sertraline, repeat PHQ-9 in 6 weeks.
- Weight
  - Status: Weight 70 kg, waist 80 cm (at female cut‑off).
  - Plan: Reduce refined carbs, walk 30 min daily.
Due: HbA1c not indicated; next review in 3 months.

memories.text: Refer to Dr. S. Rao, Psychiatry, for evaluation of persistent depressive symptoms despite antidepressant trial.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Psychiatrist notes: Patient engaged, diagnosis moderate depressive disorder, recommends continuing current regimen, add CBT, review in 6 weeks.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Eye exam: Visual acuity 6/6 both eyes, intra‑ocular pressure 14 mmHg, fundus normal. No diabetic retinopathy (patient not diabetic).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Depression
  - Status: PHQ-9 8 (mild), reports better mood, occasional insomnia.
  - Plan: Stop mirtazapine (not prescribed), reduce sertraline to 25 mg OD, continue escitalopram 10 mg OD, repeat PHQ-9 in 4 weeks.
- Weight
  - Status: Weight 71 kg, waist 82 cm (slightly above female cut‑off).
  - Plan: Limit sugary drinks, increase vegetable intake.
Due: HbA1c not indicated; next review in 3 months.

memories.text: TSH 2.2 mIU/L. Vitamin B12 360 pg/mL. Lipid profile: Cholesterol 180 mg/dL (<200), HDL 48 mg/dL (>40), LDL 100 mg/dL (<130), Triglycerides 110 mg/dL (<150).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Sertraline 25 mg OD after breakfast
Escitalopram 10 mg OD after dinner

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Sleep has improved, I’m falling asleep by 11 pm and waking refreshed. Mood feels steadier.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Depression
  - Status: PHQ-9 5 (minimal), reports good energy, sleep 7‑8 hrs.
  - Plan: Continue current doses, consider tapering escitalopram if stable for 3 months, repeat PHQ-9 in 8 weeks.
- Weight
  - Status: Weight 70 kg, waist 80 cm (at cut‑off).
  - Plan: Maintain balanced diet, regular walk.
